address: contrada Torre Garga SS 107, San Giovanni in Fiore, 87055, Italy
bio: Located on the wooded Sila plateau famous since Greek times, this restaurant aims to take guests on a culinary voyage through the region, from the hills overlooking the sea to the high mountain peaks. Although spanning just a short distance, this covers a fertile area which boasts a rich diversity of ingredients. Enhanced by the experience of chef Antonio Biafora, the restaurant’s focus is on top-quality local produce (vegetables, aromatic herbs, walnuts etc) sourced from local farmers and growers, creating a chain which is both economic and socially responsible. In addition to its à la carte options, guests also have the choice of two tasting menus, the regional character of which is emphasised by their Calabrian names (Pùzaly and Chjùbica).
